offence_note: Sexual assault with weapon, sexual assault, unlawful confinement, weapon dangerous purpose
sentence_quote: The appellant, Dean Bradley Scott, was found to be a dangerous offender on July 31, 2000. Accordingly, he was sentenced to detention in a penitentiary for an indeterminate period.
note: Appeal from dangerous offender designation dismissed; long-term offender option rejected.

offence_note: Second degree murder of common-law partner
sentence_quote: Mr. Butcher has already been sentenced to life in prison. I set his parole ineligibility at 15 years, that is, he must serve 15 years before he can apply for parole.
note: Decision sets parole ineligibility; 880 days custody counts toward the 15 years.

offence_note: Participating in Stanley Cup riot, assault, assaulting a peace officer
sentence_quote: I sentence Mr. Anderson to 15 months in jail on the count of participating in a riot, to be reduced by five and a half months' credit for pre‑trial custody.
note: Credit stated as five and a half months; 8 months concurrent on each assault.

offence_note: Firearm offences at Rideau Hall and mischief over $5,000
note: Only s. 684 motion for appointed counsel dismissed; underlying sentence 6 years less 1 year credit.

offence_note: Manslaughter, aggravated assault, two assaults causing bodily harm in custody
sentence_quote: To summarize, I sentence you to seven years' imprisonment in respect of the offences of manslaughter and aggravated assault. You are sentenced to nine months' concurrent for each of the charges of assault causing bodily harm.
note: Other order: one extra day in lieu of victim surcharge; other mitigating: no premeditation.

offence_note: Sexual assault of 15-year-old by adult in position of trust
sentence_quote: He received a sentence of 1 year imprisonment and 2 years probation.

offence_note: Production of cannabis for medical compassion club
sentence_quote: I would substitute a conditional discharge for a period of 12 months for the fine and probation order previously imposed.
note: $3,000 fine and 12 months probation replaced by 12-month conditional discharge; other: compassionate motive.

offence_note: Human trafficking, material benefit, avails of minor, procuring for sex trade
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to 8.5 years in custody less credit for pre‑sentence custody and strict bail conditions of 11 months, leaving a balance of 7 years and 7 months to be served.
note: Fine is in lieu of forfeiture; other ancillary orders not specified.

offence_note: Sexual assault (predicate offence for dangerous offender designation)
sentence_quote: I have decided that he must be declared a dangerous offender, and he is therefore sentenced to detention for an indeterminate period pursuant to s. 753(4) of the Code.

offence_note: Attempted murder, aggravated assault, use of firearm
sentence_quote: On March 20, 2024, I sentenced Travis Bowcock to: 1) 14 years in prison for attempted murder; 2) Seven years in prison for aggravated assault, concurrent to the sentence for attempted murder;
note: Ruling declining s. 743.6 delayed parole; sentence imposed March 20, 2024; credit amount not stated.
